bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SATURDAY MORNING... Combined seas 14 to 16 ft becoming 20 to 24 ft Friday evening, then becoming 16 to 20 ft Saturday. Bar conditions severe. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 630 PM Friday, and 715 AM and 715 PM Saturday.
